“ I worked hard, so I deserve to play hard! „

Sunburnt Surfer is a Super Epic Costume for Cappuccino Cookie. It is his first Costume, accompanying his release in the second half of the Face the Trial! update. It can be obtained either by drawing it from the Costume Gacha or by purchasing it in the Rainbow Crystal Shop.

The Costume represents Cappuccino Cookie taking the vacation he has prepared for so long, following the events of Roguefort Cookie's arrest trial.

Story

Under the blazing sun, this sunburnt Cookie is brimming with energy like never before! It's Cappuccino Cookie, and he is finally on the long-awaited vacation he has been dreaming of. Riding the waves, enjoying the cool waters, and when he gets tired, he returns to the beach to indulge in a refreshing nap. Be it at work or on vacation—Cappuccino Cookie remains fully committed to the present moment!

Quotes

General

  • How nice it would be if everyone just admitting to their wrongdoings.
  • Okay, now... Forget about work and focus on resting...
  • Finally... Some time off...
  • Empty your mind before refilling again.
  • Lie down in a hammock and play the ukulele!
  • Justice lives within all of us.
  • A nap under the palm tree... Now, that's a paradise on Earthbread!

Tired

  • Sigh... I don't want to go to work...

Lobby

Daily Gift

  • I worked hard, so I deserve to play hard!

Tap

  • Coming here after finishing a major trial is a great feeling!
  • Focus on the present.
  • This pineapple surfboard is custom made!
  • You need to have a hobby to endure daily life!
  • I haven't been on a vacation in a long time.
  • The time has come to show my vacation shirt hiding under my robes!
  • Ah, look at the waves... Let's go surfing!
  • I fell asleep on the sunbed, and now I'm sunburnt...
  • I need to enjoy my time off while I can. Maybe I'll go yachting tomorrow.
  • I feel recharged when I sit by the ocean at night and gaze up at the stars...

Gift

  • I feel well-rested! Now, back to work. (Given Well-Ironed Robe)
  • How luxurious! This welcome gift is nice. (Given Royal Golden Dough)
  • Evidence, is it...? I'll take a look after my vacation. (Neutral)


The following are reused from the Cookie's base quotes.

General

  • It is my job to make justice prevail.
  • Yeah, yeah... See you in court.
  • It doesn't hurt to be nice and honest to one another, you know?

Trivia

  • Sunburnt Surfer and  Tropical Escape's gacha illustrations make one big picture when put together side by side.
  • Sunburnt Surfer was released alongside  Professional Vacationer and  Summer Cherry Punch.
